title: The AI Ethical Resonance Hypothesis: The Possibility of Discovering Moral Meta-Patterns in AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a theoretical framework that proposes evaluating cultural bias through cross-cultural validation methodologies, methodological triangulation across diverse datasets, and blind expert evaluations to ensure AI-identified moral meta-patterns do not exhibit systematic cultural biases.

The paper proposes theoretical evaluations where AI systems analyze datasets containing ethical dilemmas from different historical periods to ensure the identified moral meta-patterns transcend historical biases rather than perpetuating them.

The paper theoretically identifies the risk of implicit bias in modular generator-verifier AI architectures and suggests evaluating and mitigating it through sensitivity analysis of training data composition (especially regarding marginalized perspectives) and cross-validation techniques.
